This project is dedicated to supporting smallholder families in rural communities in Petén. They are exposed to the effects of climate change, which have a negative impact on their harvests. By implementing agroecological measures, they are strengthened in their resilience and apply adaptation measures. This enables them to stabilise their food situation and improve their living conditions, which are characterised by various forms of poverty.
